rounds.note: NO SCORE EXISTS FOR ROUND 0. Do not later quote one. The round nevertheless produced three real criticals.

criticals_found_and_all_ADJUDICATED_BY_M.claim: f_const = max over labels of noisy marginals on one finite sample is upward-biased even under exactly uniform gold labels (winner's curse); the paper never calibrated it
criticals_found_and_all_ADJUDICATED_BY_M.main_verdict: CONFIRMED and LARGER than the reviewer computed (40k multinomial draws per construct at the paper's own (n,k)). All six constructs' reported floor-above-chance gaps fall INSIDE the 95th percentile of pure selection noise. OBQA: E[max]-chance = 2.315 pp (reviewer said 1.017) vs reported gap 2.600 pp, q95 = 4.400 pp.
criticals_found_and_all_ADJUDICATED_BY_M.fix: tab_nulls gained E[f_hat]/q95/p under the balanced null; abstract scoped to the 3 surviving constructs (MMLU-Pro, MMLU, BoolQ)

criticals_found_and_all_ADJUDICATED_BY_M.claim: the v1>=v2 ordering is proved only for the UNSTRATIFIED mixture bound
criticals_found_and_all_ADJUDICATED_BY_M.main_verdict: CONFIRMED. argmax over labels differs from the global best constant in 4 of 8 n_opt strata (623/12032 items); proof slack 0.2992 pp.
criticals_found_and_all_ADJUDICATED_BY_M.fix: 03_method.tex:62 restated as a MEASURED property with its margin, not an identity

criticals_found_and_all_ADJUDICATED_BY_M.claim: the flip claim holds its two sides to different evidentiary standards
criticals_found_and_all_ADJUDICATED_BY_M.main_verdict: CONFIRMED. Floor side carried ci95+bootstrap p+McNemar; chance side had no inference at all. Under ONE standard the flip is 3/12 vs 1/12, not 10/12 vs 1/12.
criticals_found_and_all_ADJUDICATED_BY_M.fix: 05_analysis gained a both-sides table; abstract updated
